barcodes_case_multiplier_ck.name: barcodes_case_multiplier_ck
barcodes_case_multiplier_ck.value: CASE WHEN kind IN ('CASE') THEN qty_multiplier > 1 ELSE qty_multiplier = 1 END

movements_price_override_ck.name: movements_price_override_ck
movements_price_override_ck.value:
unit_price IS NULL OR list_price IS NULL
          OR unit_price = list_price
          OR price_override_reason IS NOT NULL

movements_price_reason_ck.name: movements_price_reason_ck
movements_price_reason_ck.value: price_override_reason IS NULL OR price_override_reason IN ('TANIDIK', 'TOPTAN', 'KAMPANYA', 'HASARLI', 'ESKI_STOK', 'YUVARLAMA', 'YONETICI_ONAYLI', 'DIGER')

movements_price_source_ck.name: movements_price_source_ck
movements_price_source_ck.value: price_source IS NULL OR price_source IN ('LIST', 'MANUAL', 'RECEIPT', 'INDEXED', 'ESTIMATED')

generated.as:
(old_currency = new_currency
  AND old_tax_mode = new_tax_mode
  AND old_price_type = new_price_type
  AND old_price_qty IS NOT NULL
  AND new_price_qty IS NOT NULL
  AND old_price_qty = new_price_qty)

CASE WHEN old_currency = new_currency
  AND old_tax_mode = new_tax_mode
  AND old_price_type = new_price_type
  AND old_price_qty IS NOT NULL
  AND new_price_qty IS NOT NULL
  AND old_price_qty = new_price_qty THEN round((new_price - old_price) * 100 / old_price, 1) END

supplier_price_changes_distinct_ck.name: supplier_price_changes_distinct_ck
supplier_price_changes_distinct_ck.value:
(old_price, old_currency, old_tax_mode, old_price_type, old_price_qty)
          IS DISTINCT FROM (new_price, new_currency, new_tax_mode, new_price_type, new_price_qty)
